analytical_question: Is the store ready to operate and sustain RFID counts?
general_et_finding: Item-level tagging has an apparel deployment precedent.
application_finding: Shadow counting can surface discrepancies without rewriting stock.
organization_specific_finding: Training, funding, equipment and sponsorship support a pilot. Closing handoffs need attention.

evidence.claim: I.T.’S. international used individually tagged garments for inventory counts in apparel stores.
evidence.date_or_recency: GS1 Japan case study, 2012; reviewed November 8, 2026.
evidence.notes: Establishes precedent; no transfer of time savings or present staffing readiness.

value_opportunity_implication: Learn whether stock records match garments.
risk_governance_implication: Keep the controller responsible for corrections.
recommendation_management_implication: Begin the controlled pilot and clarify closing-shift ownership during implementation.
change_monitoring_triggers: Review unresolved discrepancies and funding after four weeks.
